english.title: Possess a class C controlled drug - Khat
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) had in your possession

(A)_[**(..SPECIFY QUANTITY..)]_
(B)_[a quantity]_

of khat , a controlled drug of class C in contravention of section 5(1) of the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971
english.legislation: Contrary to section 5(2) of and Schedule 4 to the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
possess khat a Class C controlled drug

investigatoraction.description: Submit a form Crimsec 38 where drugs are seized

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This offence may be disposed of by the issue of a Penalty Notice for Disorder - DB32(i) Simple possession of khat is a lower tier (£60) PND offence (see section 1 Criminal Justice and Police Act 2001).
